issues.actual: Probe run this loop: tools/bin/focusboard-verify --doctor printed {"tool":"focusboard-native-webdriver",...} (native doctor, schema_version 1, tauri-driver/WebKitWebDriver entries only) instead of focusboard-verify's own doctor (schema_version 2 with npm/cargo/xvfb inventory and native_driver_ready). diagnosis.root_cause: prd_implementation_review fails because no runtime evidence exists past the anonymous auth shell, and the instrument that would produce it is unreachable: tools/focusboard_native_webdriver.py executes runpy.run_path(..., run_name='__main__') at module level and tools/tauri_verify.py imports it at line 35, so any focusboard-verify invocation dispatches into the native-webdriver argparse and never reaches its own white_box (typescript, vite-build, rust-unit, rust-check) plus black_box pipeline. Because the lane never runs, the implemented FocusView/CalendarView/SettingsView and 27-command backend remain runtime-unproven, the focusboard:// warm/cold activation has no activating scenario, and cargo fmt debt persists across src-tauri sources. This is broken measurement infrastructure plus missing scenario coverage, not missing product implementation.

stop_conditions: Stop the white-box repair and report blocked with the probe output if the runtime boundary forbids editing the tauri_verify import chain, rather than working around the registered entry.
Stop if making the lane pass would require weakening the least-privilege capabilities, the default CSP, or the evidence redaction rules.
Stop if signed-in captures would require adding non-test IPC commands or altering the 27-command contract, and propose an isolation approach instead.
Report blocked rather than successful if the replay scenario cannot exercise deep-link activation through the harness-registered surface.
Stop and report if extending the self-drive or scenario would regress the preserved native launch slice, auth-shell presentation, or tauri_source_manifest check.

strategy.rationale: The gate fails on evidence availability, not product absence: views, 27 IPC commands, reminders, and the focusboard:// mechanism exist in source while every bound receipt stops at the auth shell. Three loops (1, 3, 5) only probed the verify lane without repairing its import-time argv hijack, so this loop replaces probe-only treatment with a direct binding repair of that single chokepoint, then extends self-drive and replay scenario instrumentation so signed-in surfaces and warm/cold activation become observable, then clears the fmt debt. Measurably different root-cause strategy: wrapper/binding repair instead of re-probing.
